controls.label: Observation x-coordinates
controls.help: x-coordinate of each observation; changing one moves that point's prediction and residual chain unless the slope is 0.

controls.label: Observation labels
controls.help: Label of each observation; changing one moves that point's residual, its square, and the sum of squared errors except when the new residual has the same magnitude as the old one.

controls.label: Slope m
controls.help: Slope m; changing it moves y_hat, the residuals, the squared residuals, and the sum of squared errors at every point whose x-coordinate is nonzero.

controls.label: Intercept b
controls.help: Intercept b; changing it shifts both predictions by the same amount, moving y_hat, the residuals, the squared residuals, and the sum of squared errors except when both residuals are 0.

visuals.title: Sum of squared errors against slope

explorations.title: Squaring erases the residual sign
explorations.instruction: Predict: set coordinates x to [0, 2], labels y to [3.5, -1.5], slope m to 0.5 and intercept b to 0.5 — what are the two squared residuals and the sum of squared errors?
explorations.observe: Residuals read +3 and -3, both squared residual bars reach 9, and the sum of squared errors reads 18.
explorations.why: Squaring maps a residual and its negation to the same nonnegative value, so L depends on residual magnitudes only; both squared residual entries are 9 because |r_i| = 3 at each point.

explorations.title: Exact fit drives the loss to zero
explorations.instruction: Predict: set coordinates x to [0, 2], labels y to [1, 3], slope m to 1 and intercept b to 1 — what are the residuals and the sum of squared errors?
explorations.observe: Both predicted values equal their labels, both residuals and both squared residuals read 0, and the sum of squared errors reads 0.
explorations.why: The line b + m*x passes through both observations, so each residual y_i - y_hat_i is 0 and each squared term vanishes; L = 0 is the smallest value the loss can take for these labels.

tests.name: residuals equal in magnitude and opposite in sign

invariants.name: every value of Sum of squared errors L is between 0 and 2900
every value of Squared residuals r_i^2 is between 0 and 1500
